name: zanker-design-intelligence
description: Run design-system generation, reference-site lookup, page-graph context, and component-catalog search for open visual decisions.

workflow.instruction: If the user attached an image or screenshot, read it and write .zanker/design-intelligence/<slug>.md before any catalog search. Do not open Studio.
Read .zanker/page-graph.json from inspect when proposing page structure.
Without a user image, run design-search.sh --design-system and reference-search.sh; save output under .zanker/design-intelligence/.
For component work, run component-search.sh for the named primitives and respect dependency order.

acceptance: User visual reference overrides catalog recommendations
Catalog never replaces existing project tokens without explicit new-system request
fallback: When python3 is missing, state that design-search did not run and use knowledge packs only.
